status.label: Not ready: 3 compile errors, removed functions

summary: src/Legacy.php does not compile on PHP 8: three removed constructs stop it (php -l only shows the first one). After that, three removed features (PHP 4 constructor, each(), mysql_*) and the mcrypt extension must be replaced, and four libraries are abandoned or far behind. Roughly 1-2 days of work plus testing.

notes.title: The file does not compile: 3 removed constructs
notes.body: The curly brace string offset ($name{0}), the (real) cast and __autoload() were removed in PHP 8.0. Each one stops compilation, and php -l reports only the first per file, so fix all three before re-scanning (the scanner lists every one).

code.note: With all three changed, php -l on 8.5.12 reports no syntax error.

notes.title: PHP 4 style constructor no longer runs
notes.body: Since PHP 8.0 a method with the class name is an ordinary method, so Legacy::Legacy() is never called and $declared stays null. Rename it to __construct(). Also declare $undeclared (dynamic property, deprecated since 8.2).

code.note: Checked on 8.5.12: the property is set, no deprecation.

notes.title: each() was removed
notes.body: each() is gone since PHP 8.0 (fatal: undefined function). For a single call, read the current element and advance the pointer; for loops, use foreach.

code.note: Gives exactly what each() returned on PHP 7.4, and moves the pointer the same way.

notes.title: Concatenation and + changed precedence
notes.body: Since PHP 8.0, + and - bind tighter than the dot. "Total: " . $n + 1 printed 1 on PHP 7.4 (with a warning) and prints "Total: 6" on 8.x. Add parentheses so the intent is explicit on every version.

notes.title: Deprecations on 8.4/8.5: implicit nullable, (integer), backticks
notes.body: All three still run but emit E_DEPRECATED on 8.5.12 (php -l shows them). Rector fixes the first two automatically.

code.note: Quote any variable part with escapeshellarg().

notes.title: Libraries and extensions to replace
notes.body: ext-mcrypt was removed from PHP (7.2): use openssl_encrypt()/sodium and make sure existing data can still be decrypted. phpoffice/phpexcel and swiftmailer/swiftmailer are abandoned; guzzle 6, monolog 1 and php-jwt 5 have newer majors that support 8.5. mysql_* (line 62) needs PDO or mysqli. acme/internal-sdk is private: check its own repository.

code.note: Different APIs: plan the migration of the calling code.
